Subject: Redwood discovery — next steps & proposal

Hi Samir / Priyanka,

Thanks again for taking the time today — good conversation. Quick recap and recommended next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Key pain: high per-token costs and unpredictable latency spikes for your inference-heavy address-normalization and search reranking workloads.
- What we recommended: 1) short POC (6 weeks) focused on the two highest-volume endpoints (normalization + rerank) with prefix caching + batching tuned for your traffic patterns; 2) run on a dedicated capacity pool so you get stable latency while you evaluate cost delta.

Proposed scope & timeline:
- Week 0: kickoff + data access and security review (Aditya will run the tech kickoff)
- Weeks 1–3: integration + tuning + perf baselining
- Weeks 4–6: production-like traffic test and cost/quality readout

Next steps
- Confirm scope and timing (do you want to start the week of Apr 4?).
- I attached a short PoC proposal with the technical scope and an initial budget estimate (redwood-poc-proposal.pdf).
- If it looks good, I’ll send a formal statement of work and Aditya will schedule the kickoff.

Open question: is procurement fine with a short non-recurring POC charge, or should we route through a procurement PO first? Knowing that will speed things up.

Thanks — I’ll hold time on my calendar for a quick next-step sync if you prefer to confirm by call.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Thanks Samir — good questions. Quick ballpark: 

- 6-week technical POC on Dedicated capacity (as scoped in the attached): ~$18k–$28k total depending on traffic (most customers land in the middle once we tune batching/caching).
- If you prefer a 6-month extended evaluation with production-like traffic, expect ~$35k–$60k spread over the term (we’d provide pricing bands and a recommended cap).
- Minimums: Dedicated pools typically have a monthly floor for guaranteed throughput; for the size you described we’d expect a monthly minimum in the $3k–$6k range, but we can make the POC non-recurring if procurement prefers a one-time engagement.

I attached a short pricing worksheet (redwood-poc-pricing.xlsx) with the assumptions we used here. Aditya will lead the tech kickoff and validate the perf assumptions once we have access.

If you want a clean quote for procurement I can generate an SOW and formal quote once you confirm the desired timeline.

Best,
Marissa
